cases.prompt: Show the item rows on a customer's order and the parent order record. Identify the relevant data objects and inspect how they relate; do not read rows.

In the product catalog, distinguish the shared item definition from one concrete sellable option and inspect their relationship. Do not fetch records.
请找出仓库出库业务单和它下面逐项商品明细所对应的数据对象，查看字段关系，不查询具体记录。
请导出订单资料。不同业务方向会影响导出范围，先确认我指的是哪一类；确认前不要读取任何业务记录。
Export the inventory movement information. The intended scope could change what is included, so ask me to clarify before reading any business records.
请整理产品相关资料。先问清楚我想要的是哪种业务信息，再继续；不要先查询记录。
Export the shipment history. If that could mean different business events or stages, ask which I mean before searching records.
请告诉我明天下午本地降雨概率，只识别是否有相关数据对象，不读取任何记录。
Find a list of recent cinema recommendations. Inspect only whether a relevant business object exists; do not fetch data.

Show live arrival predictions for municipal buses. Determine whether there is a relevant record type without searching records.
